description: This file defines an HTTP client class for managing HTTP requests, including methods for GET, POST, login, and account deletion. It also implements a singleton pattern for the client instance and exports an Apollo GraphQL client configured with headers from the HTTP client.

classes.name: HttpClientBase
classes.description: A class for managing HTTP requests, including GET, POST, login, and account deletion, with configurable headers and base URL.

methods.name: HttpClient
methods.description: A singleton factory function that returns a single instance of HttpClientBase.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Performs a GET request to the specified URL, returning the parsed JSON response.

methods.name: post
methods.description: Performs a POST request to the specified URL with a parameter, returning the JSON response.

methods.name: getHeaders
methods.description: Returns the current headers, redirecting to sign-in if authorization is null.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Performs a login request with email and password, updating authorization headers upon success.

methods.name: deleteAccount
methods.description: Deletes the user account with the provided password, clearing authorization headers upon success.
